messages.subject: Should I choose Z4 or Z5 (figures attached)?
parts:
Hello Gavin,

I have Z4 and Z5 figures attached here. Could you confirm my interpretation?

Z4:
Log likelihood: -3250960.6836
S_Dbw dens.bw (LogRatio): 0.0062 
S_Dbw scat (LogRatio): 0.0516 
S_Dbw validity index (LogRatio): 0.0579 
S_Dbw dens.bw (AllelicRatio): 0.1803 
S_Dbw scat (AllelicRatio): 0.0310 
S_Dbw validity index (AllelicRatio): 0.2113 
S_Dbw dens.bw (Both): 0.1865 
S_Dbw scat (Both): 0.0827 
S_Dbw validity index (Both): 0.2692 

Z5:
Log likelihood: -3174420.1812
S_Dbw dens.bw (LogRatio): 0.0155 
S_Dbw scat (LogRatio): 0.0463 
S_Dbw validity index (LogRatio): 0.0617 
S_Dbw dens.bw (AllelicRatio): 0.1452 
S_Dbw scat (AllelicRatio): 0.0238 
S_Dbw validity index (AllelicRatio): 0.1690 
S_Dbw dens.bw (Both): 0.1607 
S_Dbw scat (Both): 0.0701 
S_Dbw validity index (Both): 0.2308 

I see Z5 with the minimum S_Dbw validity index, so I should pick Z5 results. When I checked the figure, it looked overfitting to me and I decided to select Z4 as the optimal result. Am I correct so far? Z3 also showed similar results to Z4.

I ran Titan with only SNPs found in dbSNP138. Thank you for your great program and support again.

Cheers, James
